decisions.title: Hosea's Marriage to Gomer
decisions.reason: Narrow to the named marriage and children; chapter 3 does not explicitly name the purchased woman as Gomer, and chapter 2 is an oracle.

published.title: Hosea's Marriage to Gomer
published.summary: At the LORD’s command Hosea marries Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim. The births and symbolic names of Jezreel, Lo-ruhamah and Lo-ammi accompany messages about Israel and Judah.
